quest.title: Friends of Moleyvalley
quest.description: This small valley doesn't seem as peaceful as it looks...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x300, Primogem x40, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x2, Mystic Enhancement Ore x3

dialogues.speaker: Auni
dialogues.text: I'm guessing the Weasel Thief Big Bosses are trying to copy the big guys and make the Moley family their flunkies.

dialogues.speaker: Auni
dialogues.text: But just like how those big guys failed, they probably didn't get their way either. Those weasels have messed up Moleyvalley, and now the Moley family are hiding in a hole somewhere.

choices.text: It's probably best not to expect too much from moles.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, they're just Sniffer Moles... and it's not like the Weasel Thieves don't already have super dangerous weapons! ...Come to think of it, it's crazy they even *have* those.

response.speaker: Auni
response.text: Moleyvalley once again belongs to Grandpa Moley and his family. As we agreed, here's your Mora. Thanks for the help!

response.speaker: Auni
response.text: Oh, yeah. Might as well give you this as well. Helka said fiction mustn't find its way into her booklet, or it'll start getting hard to tell truth from falsehood.

response.speaker: Auni
response.text: I'm not sure it matters... Even false things contain some truth, don't they?

response.speaker: Auni
response.text: #Anyway, I'll see you around, {NICKNAME}, Littlest Miss Paimon. I'll come find you again if the Weasel Thief Big Bosses try anything funny.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Hehe, looks like our reputation's a-growin', {NICKNAME}! Paimon really hopes those weasels don't try anything funny again. You take care, Auni!

response.speaker: Auni
response.text: I will. Safe travels, you two!

choices.text: They relied on humans for that as well.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, these are just Sniffer Moles, after all... And if we look at this differently, the Weasel Thieves only got their hands on dangerous machines because of humans. It's only right that humans should clean up the mess that other humans created!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You're not sure what's going on, but you approach the little girl...
Watch out for those Weasel Thieves. They've been hanging out in Moleyvalley for a while now. If they get you, you'll become a person with no shadow, too.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Weasel Thieves? Where? Also, what do you mean, "person with no shadow"...?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa! What's up with that machine? Are the Weasel Thieves using it to attack us?
Those ones were raised by humans — might even be smarter than humans, too. That's how they chased all the big guys away.

Now — and the big guys have tried and failed to do this before — you just have to <color=#00E1FFFF>remove the energy core</color>, and you're golden. They've never actually done it, though, so it can't be that easy.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hmm, we can stop the Weasel Thieves by grabbing the energy core, right? C'mon, {NICKNAME}, why don't we give it a go?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We can't just ignore something dangerous like that when there's a little kid running around.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Seeing as it's the great Paimon asking, I could never refuse!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Just keep your head down here, okay, lil' miss? ... Oh, right. What's your name again?

dialogues.speaker: Auni
dialogues.text: ...Aren't you the "littlest" miss here? I don't get it... Whatever, I'm Auni, and you should call me "Big Sis," littlest miss. It's only proper.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Uhm... Let's just leave the titles aside for now... Come on, {NICKNAME}. We've got Weasel Thieves to bring down a peg or two!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Heh. It's the end of the line for you now!

dialogues.speaker: Auni
dialogues.text: Huh. This is my first time seeing the Weasel Thief Big Boss up close... Oh, yeah. You've gotta call him Big Boss too, Paimon!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wha... Fat chance Paimon's gonna call some Weasel Thief "Big Boss"!

dialogues.speaker: Auni
dialogues.text: You're right. Bad kids can't be bosses, can they? And no one's going to attend their funerals either... if they even hold 'em.

dialogues.speaker: Auni
dialogues.text: Oh, right! I heard Helka say that there are strange people who eat strange meat, such as meat from Weasel Thieves. And there are those who like to collect specimens...

dialogues.speaker: Auni
dialogues.text: Whether eating them or collecting them, there won't be any need for a funeral afterward.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, Auni... Are you seriously saying all that scary stuff with a straight face?

dialogues.speaker: Weasel Thief Big Boss
dialogues.text: (This one looks terrified...)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Stop! Don't you dare run!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? It doesn't seem to be running... but waiting for us? Well, let's go see what's up.

dialogues.speaker: Auni
dialogues.text: #Wow, you were way stronger than those big guys, {NICKNAME}. I guess size isn't everything!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hehe, right? {NICKNAME}'s not the tallest person ever, but {M#he}{F#she} can thrash monsters ten times {M#his}{F#her} size, easy!

choices.text: Oh, please, I just dabble. Paimon's the real thrasher.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh—!? Umm, flattery won't get you... W—Well, it might get you... half Paimon's share next time we eat something nice, how's that sound?

response.speaker: Auni
response.text: #Then you can kick the Weasel Thief Big Bosses out of Moleyvalley, right, {NICKNAME}? This isn't their home, but they're always making a mess of it anyway.

response.speaker: Auni
response.text: Funerals that should have been held can't be, and Grandpa Moley might've gotten killed because of them, too. But if we're going to hold new funerals, we'll have to find all of them first.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh!? Did Weasel Thieves really... Also, can Paimon ask... When you say funerals, do you mean that people want to hold them here? Why here, of all places...

response.speaker: Auni
response.text: Of course they do. I've made all the preparations, and I've thought of what songs to sing, too. Here, have a look — but do be quiet. Let him rest quietly.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Auni takes a small matchbox from her pocket and opens it. A beautifully-colored beetle lies on a flowery lining cloth within. There are even a few white petals adorning the scene...

response.speaker: Auni
response.text: He's gone to his eternal rest, so we've got to hold a funeral for him. But all the places I picked are those small hills with machines on 'em, and they've all been occupied by Weasel Thieves.

response.speaker: Auni
response.text: If Grandpa Moley's family haven't fled by now, they're probably dead. That's how badly the Weasel Thieves destroyed their home.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #({NICKNAME}, do you think this "Grandpa Moley" guy she talks about is actually...)

choices.text: (Some sort of small animal, I suspect.)

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: (Yeah, Paimon thinks so too. Probably an animal friend of hers.)

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm. How about we help you catch these no-good, evil-doing Weasel Thieves? And as for Grandpa Moley's family... We can look for them once we've brought those thieves to justice. How's that sound?

response.speaker: Auni
response.text: Huh. You're real good people, you two. I'll invite you to the funeral for sure.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, you don't have to do that, exactly...

response.speaker: Auni
response.text: Okay. In that case, you can have the sugar sculpture I bought earlier— Huh, I guess it's already gone.

response.speaker: Auni
response.text: Well, I've still got the pocket money Jurva gave me — you can take that and buy some sugar sculptures for yourselves.

response.speaker: Auni
response.text: If you ask people for help, you gotta repay 'em, and you gotta say thanks. That's the right way to do things.

choices.text: Ah, Paimon. To think you would seize candy from the tiny hands of children...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hang on! Why're you making Paimon out to be some kinda villain? Still, you're super polite for a little kid, Auni.

response.speaker: Auni
response.text: Thanks! But you're each getting enough Mora for only one sugar sculpture. Buttering me up won't get you any extra.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And then you're surprisingly practical about things like this... It seems like we're dealing with more than one weaselly Weasel Thief, right?

response.speaker: Auni
response.text: Yup, that's right. The one that ran off just now isn't the Weasel Thief Big Boss I saw before. In fact, I've got no clue how many brothers he has.

response.speaker: Auni
response.text: But you can find the same robo-claws that fire bullets over there, so we might also find more Weasel Thieves there, too.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright. We're not letting those Weasel Thieves get away this time. We're gonna teach 'em a lesson!

choices.text: An admirable sense of decorum indeed.
(It could be someone who used to live here.)

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: (Huh? But this place doesn't look like it's had any long-term residents... It's probably one of her animal friends instead! She even does funerals for beetles, after all.)

choices.text: I don't go easy on small monsters either!

dialogues.speaker: Auni
dialogues.text: Should we bury it by the sea, or on top of some small hill...?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Y'know, Paimon's just noticed that all the Weasel Thieves fled toward that little hill over there...

dialogues.speaker: Auni
dialogues.text: Yeah, and it's something the big guys who trained the Weasel Thieves brought over. The Weasel Thief Big Boss used it to beat the big guys up — sent them rolling and crawling!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Aaanyway, let's go to that hill and investigate. Keep your eyes open for a Weasel Thief ambush, {NICKNAME} — Paimon would rather not roll... or crawl!

choices.text: If only I'd been there at the time...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, would you have wanted to help? ... No, you just want to watch the mess unfold!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright. Time to surrender...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh!? Seriously? They all ran!? And in different directions, too!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, Auni, each of us gets one. Don't let 'em get away this time!

talks.objective: Catch up with the Weasel Thief

dialogues.speaker: Auni
dialogues.text: Ooh, look! It's the whole Moley family. Grandpa, Papa, Mama, Lil' Moley, Little Lil' Moley... and all the rest.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, so they're Sniffer Moles! Wait, how do you tell them apart? They all look the same to Paimon.

dialogues.speaker: Auni
dialogues.text: By their personalities, of course! You'll understand if you get to know 'em.

dialogues.speaker: Auni
dialogues.text: But they all have the same bad habit of begging for stuff from humans. *sigh* Poor critters. If we went extinct, what would happen to them?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Humans? Go extinct? While Sniffer Moles survive? H—How could that happen?

dialogues.speaker: Auni
dialogues.text: Big Sis Linnea says that animals go extinct for all sorts of reasons. That means humans can go extinct, too. How do you not know that, Littlest Miss Paimon?

choices.text: I'd like to think I'll outlast the Sniffer Moles, at least...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But that doesn't really answer Auni's question, does it? Hmm... Come to think of it, humans really are in a scary spot with all these threats out there...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Anyway, back on topic — what're we going to do about these Weasel Thieves now that we've found our moles?

response.speaker: Auni
response.text: If no one's got a better idea, let's just hand them over to The Flagship...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Treasure! Or is it a bribe in this situation? Eh, whatever. Since they're giving it to us, we might as well take it.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Well, they seem sorry, at least. Let's let 'em off the hook this time, {NICKNAME} — but not because they gave us treasure, of course!

choices.text: They say that insects predate humans...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: And they'll probably still be around when we're gone.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, so humans are gonna lose to insects? ... Ugh, Paimon's kinda peeved by that!

talks.objective: Catch up with the Weasel Thief

dialogues.speaker: Auni
dialogues.text: Great. Everyone's still here, and no one's turned into a shadowless mole.

dialogues.speaker: Auni
dialogues.text: Oh, right. Still gotta hold that funeral. I wonder if I should invite the others from the Conch Gang...

choices.text: Tell me about the Conch Gang...

response.speaker: Auni
response.text: Oh, would you like to join, too? If you do, Jurva's the guy to ask. He'll be at "Speranza." Though, if there's gonna be a vote, Helka's not around right now...

response.speaker: Auni
response.text: But that's fine. I'm sure Jurva will find a way.

response.speaker: Auni
response.text: I'd guess they started picking up human habits from living alongside us for so long. Weasel Thieves do this too — and so do the saurians in Natlan, or so I'm told.

response.speaker: Auni
response.text: I'm not sure if it's a good thing or a bad thing, though...

response.speaker: Auni
response.text: Safe travels!

dialogues.speaker: Auni
dialogues.text: I just need a moment to get ready, then I'll catch him for sure...
